source_units.text: Propose a desk arrangement for a fictional shared workspace.
Use a practical and considerate voice.
The full text must be between 55 and 85 words.
Use this fictional material: The layout places frequently shared stationery in a shared tray, drawing materials on the window side, and keeps a clear center for exchanging large sheets.
Each person retains one private corner.
Required wording, verbatim: "shared tray", "window side", "clear center".
